contexts.text: Monstrously deformed faces, especially those of old women, appear there.
Women, although they had been old women return into the flower of their age and beauty. CL 137:7.
Regards his consort as a tiresome old woman.
The love of adultery is represented there by an old woman, whose deformity is such that she inspires the beholder with cold and the death of all the deliciousness of life.
